Commands (a line with / is never sent as a message):
/join #channel - go there, /part - leave the channel, /who - who is here, /help - this help
/me text - an action, /topic text - the channel's topic, /msg nick text - a private message
/kick, /ban, /unban, /mute, /unmute nick - for the room's owner and staff
